title: Emaar Crescent Bay Coastal Towers
summary: 1,200 luxury waterfront suites specified with Clipsal Vivace switching matrices and ABB circuit protection.
challenge: Delivering a consistent premium switchline, dependable protection and a single supplier chain across a phased high-rise handover of more than a thousand units.
solution: Powerhouse staged factory-certified Clipsal and ABB stock against the handover schedule, ran a 24-hour priced BOQ SLA for every variation, and trained the site electrical teams on the specified schedules.
scope: 1,200 luxury units • Switching, sockets & circuit protection

title: Lucky One Mall Karachi
summary: Main low-voltage power distribution, Himel industrial molded-case breakers and emergency switchgear for one of Asia's largest malls.
challenge: A retail megaplex cannot flicker: distribution had to be selective, maintainable live, and sourced without counterfeits in a market flooded with them.
solution: Powerhouse supplied certified Himel MCCBs and distribution gear with certificates of origin, coordinated staged deliveries around mall hours and backed the install with 24-hour spares support.
scope: Multi-megawatt LV distribution • Switchgear supply & schedule

title: Dolmen Executive Towers Clifton
summary: Enterprise structured cabling backbone on Schneider Actassi Cat6A shielded copper with fibre patch enclosures.
challenge: Corporate tenants demanded 10-gigabit-ready risers and floor distribution with end-to-end certification — inside occupied towers.
solution: Actassi copper and fibre trunks were factory-terminated, tested and handed over with channel reports, racked in enclosed 42U cabinets with managed containment.

title: Serena Hotels & Resorts
summary: Guest Room Management Systems, digital door access and centralised smart scene control across luxury suites.
challenge: Five-star comfort at hotel economics: guest rooms that save energy when empty, doors that log every entry, and scenes that feel effortless.
solution: Riva GRMS with keycard power switching, Lockly digital deadbolts and BlueDot scene panels were commissioned floor by floor, integrated with the property network.

title: Habib Metro Bank Corporate Centre
summary: Turnkey wiring accessories and ABB surge protection across the headquarters and branch network.
challenge: A banking network needs identical, authentic hardware in every branch — procured centrally, installed by many contractors.
solution: Powerhouse issued a standardised accessory schedule (Clipsal switchlines, ABB SPDs and DBs), held central stock and delivered branch by branch against the fit-out calendar.
scope: Head office & branch network • Accessories & protection

title: Packages Group Infrastructure
summary: Heavy industrial switchgear, IP66 metalclad socket systems and high-amperage protection for plant operations.
challenge: Dust, load and uptime: plant electrical rooms needed genuine breaking capacity and connectors that survive industrial abuse.
solution: ABB and Himel protection, ESM metalclad outlets and VTEKE fuses were supplied with manufacturer documentation, plus on-site training for maintenance crews.
